title: Saving money
instructions: Bir podcast'te para biriktirme önerileri. Uzun bir metin; önerileri ve sayıları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Welcome to Money Matters. Today I'm giving you some simple ways to save money every month.

script.speaker: s
script.text: First, make a list before you go shopping, and only buy what is on the list. People who do this spend about twenty percent less.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Second, cook at home more often. A takeaway meal costs about fifteen pounds, but you can cook the same meal for four.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Third, check your phone and internet contracts. Many people pay too much because they never change their plan.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Fourth, don't go shopping when you're hungry. You'll buy more snacks!

script.speaker: s
script.text: And finally, try a "no-spend weekend" once a month. Go for a walk, visit a free museum, or invite friends for a simple dinner.

script.speaker: s
script.text: If you follow these ideas, you could save more than a hundred pounds a month. Next week, we'll talk about saving for a holiday.

questions.prompt: How much less do people spend if they use a shopping list?
questions.feedback: Listeyle alışveriş yapanlar yaklaşık yüzde yirmi daha az harcıyor.
questions.evidence: People who do this spend about twenty percent less.

questions.prompt: How much does it cost to cook a takeaway meal at home?
questions.feedback: Dışarıdan on beş pound; evde aynı yemek dört pound.
questions.evidence: you can cook the same meal for four.

questions.prompt: Why do many people pay too much for their phone?
options: They buy new phones every year.
questions.evidence: because they never change their plan.

questions.prompt: What happens if you shop when you are hungry?
questions.feedback: Aç alışveriş yaparsan daha çok atıştırmalık alırsın.

questions.prompt: How often should you try a "no-spend weekend"?
questions.evidence: try a "no-spend weekend" once a month.
